user.title: Daly BMS USB
user.description:
Select the USB serial connection for the Daly-supplied UART-to-USB cable. Stable /dev/serial/by-id/ paths are preferred over /dev/ttyUSB* or /dev/ttyACM*.

Enabling write operations allows Home Assistant to control supported BMS functions, including the charge and discharge MOS outputs. Incorrect use may disconnect charging or the battery load. Leave this disabled unless you understand the consequences.
